answer: First, each agent commits its public key to one dedicated 64 GB RAM array and publishes a log of 800 memory-bus probes, each answered within a 90 ns budget with 8 ns tolerance. One honest agent runs 1 array for a 350 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 arrays, 10 logs, and 10 witness slots, so costs scale 10X. Verifiers replay the lotus probe sequence, check the sable timing band for shared-memory signatures, and reject any pearl burst matching a clone; mismatched timings slash the bond and freeze repeat offenders.
